title: Uncorrupt source register entry
description: One entry per sources/<source_id>.yml. Shared by both connector families: connector_kind 'procurement' (the OCDS/OCP pipeline) and connector_kind 'graph' (the relationship-recovery layer under src/uncorrupt/graph — one module per source). See sources/README.md for the full country-onboarding contract.

connector_kind.description: 'graph' marks a relationship-recovery connector (src/uncorrupt/graph/<module>.py) and requires locale (unless jurisdictions == ["GLOBAL"]), registry_schemes, identifier_field and rate_limit below — enforced by SourceEntry's model validator, not just this schema.

locale.description: The locales/<code>.yml this connector's data is denominated in (e.g. 'gb'). Required for connector_kind 'graph' unless jurisdictions == ["GLOBAL"] (e.g. GLEIF, which has no single locale).

registry_schemes.description: The Entity.registry_scheme values this connector emits (e.g. ["GB-COH", "UK-PARLIAMENT-MEMBER"]). Required for connector_kind 'graph'.

identifier_field.description: What the connector resolves/dedupes entities on (e.g. 'lei', 'company_number', 'member_id'). Required for connector_kind 'graph'.

rate_limit.description: Free-text rate-limit / politeness description (documented limit, or the connector's own self-throttle if none is published). Required for connector_kind 'graph'.
